3. Then fetch Microsoft stock market data for past 60 days and past 120 days.

Then call again with frequency="annually".

Then call `stock_market_data` twice: once with days=60, once with days=120.

We'll first call corporate_finance_dividend_data(company="Microsoft", years=5, frequency="quarterly"). Then call corporate_finance_dividend_data(company="Microsoft", years=5, frequency="annually"). Then call stock_market_data(company="Microsoft", days=60). Then call stock_market_data(company="Microsoft", days=120).
